Interface StoreApi

All Known Implementing Classes:
MStore, SqlStore
public interface StoreApi
Persistence SPI for M globals and locals (JvMumps / mJVM shared). Implementations: MStore (in-memory) and SqlStore (SQLite). path is subscript chain; global selects ^NAME vs local. Values are MValue; numeric strings are stored as text.
